title: nepeta camphorata var. heldreichii
intro: Nepeta camphorata var. heldreichii, commonly known as mountain mint, is a plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of mountain mint include its ability to soothe digestive issues, relieve respiratory problems, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
